SimScale

SimScale

SimScale provides browser-based engineering simulation for fluids, structures and thermal studies.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare a cloud simulation

Start from the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended SimScale preview, prepare a cloud simulation; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Run a parameter study

Begin with the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended SimScale preview, run a parameter study; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Compare result fields

Use the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended SimScale preview, compare result fields; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
